mapper.insert: insert into marketing_attribution (order_type, order_id, credential_id, sharer_member_id, campaign_key, claimed_member_id, order_created_at, snapshot_hash, create_time) values (#{orderType}, #{orderId}, #{credentialId}, #{sharerMemberId}, #{campaignKey}, #{claimedMemberId}, #{orderCreatedAt}, #{snapshotHash}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select id, order_type as orderType, order_id as orderId, credential_id as credentialId, sharer_member_id as sharerMemberId, campaign_key as campaignKey, claimed_member_id as claimedMemberId, order_created_at as orderCreatedAt, snapshot_hash as snapshotHash, create_time as createTime from marketing_attribution where order_type = #{orderType} and order_id = #{orderId}

select #{campaignKey} as campaignKey, #{targetType} as targetType, #{targetId} as targetId, count(*) as attributedOrders, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as paidOrders, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 2 then coalesce(r.payable_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as paidAmount, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as refundedOrders, coalesce(sum(case when r.payment_status = 4 then coalesce(r.payable_amount, 0) else 0 end), 0) as refundedAmount from marketing_attribution a join marketing_referral_credential c on c.id = a.credential_id and c.sharer_member_id = #{sharerMemberId} and c.campaign_key = #{campaignKey} and c.target_type = #{targetType} and c.target_id = #{targetId} left join cms_registration r on r.id = a.order_id and a.order_type = 1 where a.sharer_member_id = #{sharerMemberId} and a.campaign_key = #{campaignKey}
